windowControls.label: Window controls
windowsSafety.capped: On Windows the chip shows {tier} at most. The git guard there is a Git Bash script (cmd and PowerShell reach it through a git.cmd wrapper); git.exe called by its full path bypasses it, Windows has no sandbox for the agent, and the memory and process watch of a run does not work yet. The policy hook and the deny rules still stop commit and push.
